headline: Congress back in pro forma mode as both chambers reconvene Tuesday with minimal legislative action planned

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate held a brief pro forma session on Friday, October 9, meeting at 1:30 p.m. and adjourning just 39 seconds later until Tuesday. No legislative business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly on Friday, October 9, meeting for just 2 minutes with no recorded votes or quorum calls. The chamber introduced 27 public bills and 4 resolutions, and filed 9 committee reports, primarily related to Small Business Administration matters.
